avis.titre: Honestly surprised me how well it worked!
avis.texte: I have very sensitive combo skin. I tried a new face lotion that gave me the worst breakout Ive ever had and dried out my skin. This mask stopped my breakout and helped clear up my skin right away! Will be buying again!

I really wanted to love this product, but it clogged my pores. I used it the day after I received it in the mail, and then again a week later. The second time I used it, it clogged my larger pores. I applied it, waited 10 minutes, then scrubbed it off with a warm, wet washcloth. Once all the product has been removed from the surface of my face, I noticed several new blackheads on various parts of my face. I had to use an extraction tool to remove them. Then I re-washed my face. What a disappointment.

I wanted to love this mask so much!! I was so disappointed that as soon as i put it on my face my skin burned so bad. I had it on for maybe a minute and my skin was left bright red after. Im not sure if im just allergic to an ingredient or the mask is too strong. I would not recommend this is you have sensitive skin.

It worked insanely well for my husbands skin , so I gave it a go. When it was on it felt really nice, didn't burn. Once I washed it off I noticed red all over my face :( now, this didn't happen to my husbands skin so I'm wondering if it's because I have more dry skin/ sensitive skin. So, for normal skin types (like my husband) absolutely recommend. For more sensitive / dry skin please do not get. My whole face is red and irritated :l
By far my favorite mud mask I've ever used. A little goes a long way and it dries instantly. I also love how easy it is to get off and how soft my skin feels after. Highly recommend.
